content.json:
#  Defender for Endpoint Passive Mode Monitor
Track changes over time and inspect the latest observed `ForceDefenderPassiveMode` registry value. Data source: `ConfigurationChange`.

parameters.name: ComputerFilter
parameters.query:
ConfigurationChange
| where isnotempty(Computer)
| summarize by Computer
| order by Computer asc
| project value = Computer, label = Computer, selected = false
parameters.label: Computers

content.title: Current Defender mode by computer

content.query:
let Events = materialize(
    ConfigurationChange
    | where ConfigChangeType =~ "Registry"
    | where ChangeCategory in~ ("Added", "Modified", "Removed")
    | where ValueName == "ForceDefenderPassiveMode"
    | where "*" in ({ComputerFilter}) or Computer in ({ComputerFilter})
);
let Counts = union
    (Events | summarize Value = count() | extend ActivityFilter = "*"),
    (Events | summarize Value = count() by ActivityFilter = ChangeCategory);
datatable(Metric:string, ActivityFilter:string, SortOrder:int) [
    "All Changes", "*", 1,
    "Added", "Added", 2,
    "Modified", "Modified", 3,
    "Removed", "Removed", 4
]
| join kind=leftouter Counts on ActivityFilter
| extend Value = coalesce(Value, 0)
| order by SortOrder asc
| project Metric, Value, ActivityFilter
content.title: Registry activity

content.json:
## Current Values
Latest observed record in the selected time range for each computer, registry key, and value name. Removed values are shown as `<removed>`.

content.query:
let ComputerInventory = materialize(
    ConfigurationChange
    | where isnotempty(Computer)
    | where "*" in ({ComputerFilter}) or Computer in ({ComputerFilter})
    | extend JoinVMUUID = tostring(VMUUID)
    | where isnotempty(JoinVMUUID)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, _ResourceId, Computer) by JoinVMUUID
    | project JoinVMUUID, ConfigComputer = Computer, InventoryObserved = TimeGenerated, InventoryResourceId = _ResourceId
);
let LatestSetting = materialize(
    ConfigurationChange
    | where ValueName == "ForceDefenderPassiveMode"
    | where "*" in ({ComputerFilter}) or Computer in ({ComputerFilter})
    | extend JoinVMUUID = tostring(VMUUID)
    | where isnotempty(JoinVMUUID)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by JoinVMUUID
    | project JoinVMUUID, SettingObserved = TimeGenerated, SettingResourceId = _ResourceId, ValueData, ValueName, ValueType, ChangeCategory
);
let LatestHeartbeat = materialize(
    Heartbeat
    | extend JoinVMUUID = tostring(VMUUID)
    | where isnotempty(JoinVMUUID)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, OSName, Computer, ComputerPrivateIPs) by JoinVMUUID
    | project JoinVMUUID, HeartbeatComputer = Computer, OSName, ComputerPrivateIPs = tostring(ComputerPrivateIPs)
);
ComputerInventory
| join kind=leftouter LatestSetting on JoinVMUUID
| extend LastObserved = coalesce(SettingObserved, InventoryObserved),
         Resource = coalesce(SettingResourceId, InventoryResourceId),
         ValueName = coalesce(ValueName, "ForceDefenderPassiveMode"),
         State = case(isnull(SettingObserved), "Does not exist", ChangeCategory =~ "Removed", "Does not exist", "Present"),
         CurrentValue = case(isnull(SettingObserved) or ChangeCategory =~ "Removed", "<does not exist>", isempty(tostring(ValueData)), "<empty>", tostring(ValueData)),
         LastAction = case(isnull(SettingObserved), "Not observed", isempty(ChangeCategory), "Snapshot", ChangeCategory)
| extend ModeFilter = iff(State == "Present" and trim(" ", CurrentValue) == "1", "Passive", "Active")
| where "{RegistryActivityFilter}" == "*" or LastAction == "{RegistryActivityFilter}"
| where "{DefenderModeFilter}" == "*" or ModeFilter == "{DefenderModeFilter}"
| join kind=leftouter LatestHeartbeat on JoinVMUUID
| extend Computer = coalesce(HeartbeatComputer, ConfigComputer)
| project LastObserved, Resource, ValueName, CurrentValue, State, LastAction, OSName, ['Computer Name'] = Computer, ComputerPrivateIPs
| order by LastObserved desc
content.title: Latest observed registry values

content.query:
let LatestHeartbeat = materialize(
    Heartbeat
    | extend JoinVMUUID = tostring(VMUUID)
    | where isnotempty(JoinVMUUID)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, OSName, Computer, ComputerPrivateIPs) by JoinVMUUID
    | project JoinVMUUID, HeartbeatComputer = Computer, OSName, ComputerPrivateIPs = tostring(ComputerPrivateIPs)
);
ConfigurationChange
| where ConfigChangeType =~ "Registry"
| where ChangeCategory in~ ("Added", "Modified", "Removed")
| where ValueName == "ForceDefenderPassiveMode"
| where "*" in ({ComputerFilter}) or Computer in ({ComputerFilter})
| where "{SelectedResource}" == "*" or _ResourceId =~ "{SelectedResource}"
| extend ConfigComputer = Computer, JoinVMUUID = tostring(VMUUID)
| extend PreviousValue = iff(isempty(tostring(PreviousValueData)), "<empty>", tostring(PreviousValueData))
| extend NewValue = iff(ChangeCategory =~ "Removed", "<removed>", iff(isempty(tostring(ValueData)), "<empty>", tostring(ValueData)))
| extend ModeFilter = iff(ChangeCategory !~ "Removed" and trim(" ", tostring(ValueData)) == "1", "Passive", "Active")
| where "{RegistryActivityFilter}" == "*" or ChangeCategory == "{RegistryActivityFilter}"
| where "{DefenderModeFilter}" == "*" or ModeFilter == "{DefenderModeFilter}"
| join kind=leftouter LatestHeartbeat on JoinVMUUID
| extend Computer = coalesce(HeartbeatComputer, ConfigComputer)
| project TimeGenerated, Resource = _ResourceId, ValueName, NewValue, PreviousValue, Action = ChangeCategory, OSName, ['Computer Name'] = Computer, ComputerPrivateIPs, Hive, RegistryKey, ValueType, FieldsChanged
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Registry change audit trail

content.query:
ConfigurationChange
| where ConfigChangeType =~ "Registry"
| where ChangeCategory in~ ("Added", "Modified", "Removed")
| where ValueName == "ForceDefenderPassiveMode"
| where "*" in ({ComputerFilter}) or Computer in ({ComputerFilter})
| summarize Changes = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), ChangeCategory
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: ForceDefenderPassiveMode changes over time

content.json:
### Notes
- Select a Registry Activity or Defender Mode tile to filter both tables. Selecting All Changes clears the activity filter.
- Active Mode combines computers where `ForceDefenderPassiveMode` is `0`, removed, or not observed; Passive Mode is value `1`.
- OS name and private IP data come from each computer's latest `Heartbeat` record in the selected time range.
- Current-state views are bounded by the selected time range. Increase the range if a computer or value has not been observed recently.
